invariants.text: customer_id in Customer must be a positive integer
category_id in Category must be a positive integer
product_id in Product must be a positive integer
order_id in Order must be a positive integer
order_item_id in OrderItem must be a positive integer
invoice_id in Invoice must be a positive integer
customer_id in Order must reference an existing Customer
category_id in Product must reference an existing Category
product_id in Product must reference an existing Product
order_id in OrderItem must reference an existing Order
order_id in Invoice must reference an existing Order
customer_id in Invoice must reference an existing Customer
stock_quantity in Product must be a non-negative integer
price in Product must be a positive integer (in cents)
status in Order must be one of: pending, confirmed, shipped, cancelled
created_at and updated_at in Order must be timestamps
order_item_id in OrderItem must be auto-incremented
order_id in OrderItem must be a foreign key referencing Order
product_id in OrderItem must be a foreign key referencing Product
quantity in OrderItem must be a positive integer
unit_price in OrderItem must equal the product's price
total_amount in Invoice must equal the sum of all OrderItem unit_price × quantity for its order
status in Order must be 'pending' when created
status in Order must be 'confirmed' only after it is updated to confirmed and before it is shipped
status in Order must be 'shipped' only after it is confirmed and before it is cancelled
status in Order must be 'cancelled' only after it is shipped or confirmed and before it is updated again
stock_quantity in Product must not be negative when an order is confirmed
stock_quantity in Product must be restored to its original value when an order is cancelled
created_at in Invoice must be the same as the order's created_at
invoice_number in Invoice must be unique
name and description in Category must be non-null strings
name and description in Product must be non-null strings
